category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, increase embedding/GRU width to 192 and reduce learning rate to 0.0007. The wider recurrent representation adds capacity while smaller updates may stabilize optimization. Retain one GRU layer, dropout 0.1, batch size 128 and maxlen 128. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading propagate the new width. Preserve tied normalized embeddings, scoring, readout, loss and training limits; enforce the required DATA_DIR lookup.

change_summary: Jointly tune GRU4Rec width to 192 and learning rate to 0.0007 for all four datasets. Existing metadata keeps predictor/checkpoint shapes consistent; retain one independent model per category.
